purpose: Representation-only correction accepting the exact retained 24-or-48-hour half-result 50-50 fallback variants while preserving the v1 population, payoff families, price gate, and zero-network boundary.

relation_contracts.ordinary_settlement: NO first-half result plus NO second-half result plus YES implied full-game result pays at least one pUSD whenever the two half results jointly imply the full result
NO full-game team win plus YES first-half team win plus YES second-half team win pays at least one pUSD because positive total goal differential requires a positive differential in at least one half

retained_raw_source.population_scope: every complete base plus halftime-result plus second-half-result soccer triple in the immutable response

rule_contract.cancellation: team win markets resolve NO and draw markets resolve YES across the three horizons, preserving a one-pUSD floor for both relation families
rule_contract.half_result_no_data_fallback: each half-result binary market explicitly resolves 50-50 after either 24 or 48 hours without acceptable data, so the two half-result legs alone pay one pUSD
rule_contract.ordinary: full-game differential equals first-half differential plus second-half differential
rule_contract.postponement: all three market families remain open until the match is completed

stopping_rules.one_or_more_strict_candidates: freeze only one current exact book batch for the deterministic best row
